rows.organisme: Ordre des architectes — Conseil national de l'Ordre des architectes
rows.notes: Law of 3 January 1977: title and practice reserved to those entered on the Order's register (kept by 17 regional councils). Ministry of Culture figure: “more than 29,500” in 2023 (primary source: the CNOA's Archigraphie 2024); ACE 2024: 30,600. No open data set of the Order's register: data.gouv.fr API search = 0 results (verified August 2026).

alternatives.nom: RIBA — Royal Institute of British Architects

rows.notes: Architects Act 1997: only the TITLE is protected, the function itself is unrestricted. 38,981 registrants at the end of 2024 (ARB 2024 annual report as cited in the press; the ARB “2024 Year in Review” gives 41,886 at the end of 2023) — the fall is due to ~2,468 struck off for non-payment in 2024. The UIA section is the RIBA (57,000 members worldwide), not the ARB. The register is searchable but there is no bulk export.

alternatives.nom: BDA — Bund Deutscher Architektinnen und Architekten

rows.notes: Federal pitfall: registration is with the chamber of the LAND; the BAK keeps no register. 142,347 members as at 1 January 2026 across 4 professions taken together; of which 115,664 Hochbauarchitekten as at 1 January 2025 (Bundeskammerstatistik PDF, verified); ACE 2024: 120,200. No national search portal: each Land chamber offers its own directory. The BAK PDFs are aggregates, not nominal lists.

rows.organisme: Ordre des architectes / Orde van Architecten (two wings: Vlaamse Raad and Conseil francophone et germanophone)
rows.notes: Law of 20 February 1939 (protection of the title and of the profession) + law of 26 June 1963 (the Order). As at 31 December 2024: 8,282 registrants in Flanders + 6,069 on the French-speaking side = 14,351 natural persons, EXCLUDING 1,597 trainees and 4,618 legal persons (Jaarverslag 2024, verified); ACE: 15,900. Figures split between two linguistic wings and ten provincial councils; the UIA section is the FAB, not the Order. Public search also available via ordredesarchitectes.be.

alternatives.nom: BNA — Koninklijke Bond van Nederlandse Architectenbureaus (agences)

rows.notes: Wet op de architectentitel: only the TITLE is protected (4 distinct titles), the act of building is unrestricted. End of 2024: 10,731 “architect” out of 13,977 registrants across all disciplines (interior 1,530, landscape 826, urban planning 890) — jaarverslag 2024 verified; ACE: 10,500. The Netherlands does NOT appear on the list of UIA member sections (verified August 2026).

rows.organisme: Bundeskammer der Ziviltechniker:innen (4 regional chambers, architects + engineers)
rows.notes: Ziviltechnikergesetz 2019: membership of the joint architects-and-engineers chamber follows automatically. As at 31 December 2025: 4,718 architects (3,181 in practice, 1,537 dormant) out of 9,798 members — statistics page verified; the ACE estimated 6,000. Do not confuse total headcount with an active authorisation (Befugnis).

rows.organisme: No national professional order — REG (voluntary A/B/C registers, Fondation des Registres suisses) + cantonal regimes in GE/TI/VD

alternatives.nom: SIA — Société suisse des ingénieurs et des architectes

rows.notes: Title not protected at federal level, no national obligation. REG = voluntary registers recognised by the Confederation. Cantonal exceptions: GE (LPAI, compulsory register of appointed professionals), TI (LEPIA, OTIA registration — public list at otia.swiss), VD (LPrA 1966, REG A/B required to sign plans). Headcount = ACE 2024, revised from 9,200 to 26,700 with the Conférence Suisse des Architectes (CSA), which is the UIA section.

rows.organisme: Royal Institute of the Architects of Ireland (statutory registration body)
rows.notes: Building Control Act 2007 (Part 3): title protected since 2007, RIAI designated “Registration Body”. 3,592 architects on the register as at 31 December 2024 (annual report verified); ~10% non-resident; ACE: 3,500. A dual role, institute + register — the count of “RIAI members” (4,805) differs from the statutory register.

rows.organisme: Ordre des Architectes et des Ingénieurs-Conseils
rows.notes: Law of 13 December 1989 (reformed in 2020): a multi-profession professional order. OAI site (consulted August 2026): 511 established architects, 202 consulting engineers, 34 interior architects, 154 town planners, 14 landscape architects. The ACE estimates 700 (including employed and cross-border architects who fall outside the directory of established practices).

rows.organisme: Amt für Volkswirtschaft — practice authorisation (Bauwesen-Berufe-Gesetz), state professional register
rows.notes: A micro-state with no chamber: a state licence (Berufsbewilligung) entered on the professional register — the official llv.li page returned 403 to the crawler, and no public consultation could be verified; no headcount could be found. The LIA (~175 members, engineers AND architects taken together) is not a registration body. Absent from the list of UIA sections.

rows.organisme: Ordre des architectes de Monaco (Conseil de l'Ordre)
rows.notes: Ordonnance-loi No. 341 of 24.03.1942 + Ordonnance souveraine 3.269 of 12.05.2011. The complete nominal register is published in the Journal de Monaco (official gazette PDF); the Order's site announces 19 registered architectes libéraux (August 2026). Distinct categories (libéraux, agréés, honoraires); no UIA section. Time series: the Tableau de l'Ordre in JO No. 8713 (20.09.2024, 2023-2025 term) counts 23 architects by direct count (the JO labels them all as conseillers, the 4 of the bureau counted again) → 19 on the Order's site in 2026.

The “llista d'arquitectes en exercici” publishes all practising registrants in full (name, address, col·legiat number) on a single HTML page — 94 entries counted on 5 August 2026 (numbers issued up to 198; 2022 press: ~138 col·legiats in all). Separate list for architects in public administration. No CSV or PDF despite the list being complete. Not to be confused with the Col·legi d'Arquitectes Tècnics. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count): 133 architects en exercici — the 94 counted ONLY the masculine token “Número de col·legiat” and missed the 37 “col·legiada” (women); plus 21 not in practice, 15 técnics, 26 perits in annexes; a 7th list, “administració pública”, seen in the menu, not harvested. COMPLETED 5 August 2026: 7th list “arquitectes a l'administració pública” harvested — 11 architects (Govern d'Andorra ×4, comuns ×7; 3 col·legiades), ZERO overlap with the other six lists (their numbers fill gaps in the 1-198 series); active headcount = 133 en exercici + 11 in administration = 144, the same rule as Tunisia/CI for public servants.
